Button Group

Button groups combine multiple buttons into a single cohesive unit. They are useful for related actions like text formatting or toggle options.

Basic Group

Group related buttons together with connected borders.

HTML
<div class="zak-btn-group">
    <button class="zak-btn zak-btn-outline-primary">Left</button>
    <button class="zak-btn zak-btn-outline-primary">Center</button>
    <button class="zak-btn zak-btn-outline-primary">Right</button>
</div>

Toolbar

Multiple button groups can be placed in a toolbar container.

HTML
<div class="zak-btn-toolbar" style="display: flex; gap: 1rem; align-items: center;">
    <div class="zak-btn-group">
        <button class="zak-btn zak-btn-outline-secondary">Edit icon</button>
        <button class="zak-btn zak-btn-outline-secondary">Delete icon</button>
    </div>
    <div class="zak-btn-group">
        <button class="zak-btn zak-btn-outline-primary">Bold</button>
        <button class="zak-btn zak-btn-outline-primary">Italic</button>
        <button class="zak-btn zak-btn-outline-primary">Underline</button>
    </div>
</div>

Vertical Group

Arrange buttons vertically using the vertical modifier.

HTML
<div class="zak-btn-group-vertical">
    <button class="zak-btn zak-btn-outline-primary">Up</button>
    <button class="zak-btn zak-btn-outline-primary">Middle</button>
    <button class="zak-btn zak-btn-outline-primary">Down</button>
</div>

With Dropdown

Combine a button group with a dropdown for split actions.

HTML
<div class="zak-btn-group">
    <button class="zak-btn zak-btn-primary">Action</button>
    <button class="zak-btn zak-btn-primary dropdown-toggle" aria-label="More options" aria-expanded="false">
        <svg class="zak-icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M6 9l6 6 6-6"/></svg>
    </button>
</div>

Sizing

Button groups inherit size from their child buttons.

HTML
<!-- Small -->
<div class="zak-btn-group">
    <button class="zak-btn zak-btn-outline-primary zak-btn-sm">Small</button>
    <button class="zak-btn zak-btn-outline-primary zak-btn-sm">Small</button>
    <button class="zak-btn zak-btn-outline-primary zak-btn-sm">Small</button>
</div>

<!-- Default -->
<div class="zak-btn-group">
    <button class="zak-btn zak-btn-outline-primary">Default</button>
    <button class="zak-btn zak-btn-outline-primary">Default</button>
    <button class="zak-btn zak-btn-outline-primary">Default</button>
</div>

<!-- Large -->
<div class="zak-btn-group">
    <button class="zak-btn zak-btn-outline-primary zak-btn-lg">Large</button>
    <button class="zak-btn zak-btn-outline-primary zak-btn-lg">Large</button>
    <button class="zak-btn zak-btn-outline-primary zak-btn-lg">Large</button>
</div>

CSS Classes

HTML
/* Button Group */
.zak-btn-group              /* Horizontal button group */
.zak-btn-group-vertical     /* Vertical button group */

/* The group removes borders between adjacent buttons */
/* First button: no right border */
/* Last button: no left border */
/* Middle buttons: no left or right border */

/* Toolbar */
.zak-btn-toolbar            /* Container for multiple button groups */

Accessibility

  • Use role="group" and aria-label on the group container to describe the purpose.
  • For toggle button groups, use aria-pressed on each button to indicate state.
  • Ensure each button within the group remains individually focusable via keyboard.
HTML
<div class="zak-btn-group" role="group" aria-label="Text alignment">
    <button class="zak-btn zak-btn-outline-primary" aria-pressed="true">Left</button>
    <button class="zak-btn zak-btn-outline-primary" aria-pressed="false">Center</button>
    <button class="zak-btn zak-btn-outline-primary" aria-pressed="false">Right</button>
</div>
